hook.say: True or false? Five U.S. geography traps, three seconds each. The last one catches almost everybody!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: New York City is the capital of New York State.
questions.fact: The state capital is Albany. New York City is just the biggest city.
questions.sayAnswer: False! The state capital is Albany. New York City is just the biggest city.

questions.q: Florida is the southernmost US state.
questions.say: Florida is the southernmost U.S. state.
questions.fact: Hawaii reaches much farther south, at Ka Lae on the Big Island.
questions.sayAnswer: False! Hawaii reaches much farther south than Florida does.

questions.q: Four US states meet at one single point.
questions.say: Four U.S. states meet at one single point.
questions.fact: At Four Corners: Arizona, Colorado, New Mexico and Utah.
questions.sayAnswer: True! At Four Corners you can touch Arizona, Colorado, New Mexico and Utah at once.

questions.q: Reno, Nevada is farther west than Los Angeles.
questions.fact: Reno is at 119.8° west. Los Angeles is at about 118.2° west.
questions.sayAnswer: True! The California coast curves east, so Reno ends up west of Los Angeles.

questions.q: The closest US state to Africa is Maine.
questions.say: The closest U.S. state to Africa is Maine.
questions.fact: Quoddy Head, Maine is about 5,076 km from the coast of Morocco.
questions.sayAnswer: True! Maine's Quoddy Head is about 5000 kilometers from Morocco. Closer than Florida!
